_comment: The optional parts of GraphVis, in one place.
Everything here is genuinely optional: heavy, slow, or wanted by a minority.
The installer offers this list at install time and the Add-ons panel in the
application reads the same file, so a component added here appears in both
without a code change in either.
extra   - the pip extra in services/python/pyproject.toml
probe   - a module whose importability means the component is present
default - offered pre-ticked by the installer
size_mb - rough download, so the choice is an informed one

components.name: Everyday scientific formats
components.summary: MATLAB .mat, HDF5, NetCDF, Excel, TDMS, instrument and statistics files, and the business and finance readers.
components.cost: Nothing noticeable. These are what most datasets are.

components.name: Marine and diving instruments
components.summary: CTD casts, ADCP, RBR, NMEA, GPX and dive-computer logs.
components.cost: Small. Most of this group needs no package at all.

components.name: Literature extraction
components.summary: Pull text, tables and numbers out of published PDFs.
components.cost: Adds a few seconds to the first extraction of a session.

components.name: Word and PDF reports
components.summary: Batch runs can write a Word or PDF report instead of only HTML.

components.name: Domain formats
components.summary: Mass spectrometry, astronomy, seismic, neuroscience, DICOM, geospatial, Access and DuckDB.
components.cost: A large download. Nothing is slower once it is installed - every reader is imported only when a file of that type is opened.

components.name: Chart reading from papers
components.summary: A vision model that reads the data back out of a chart in a paper that published no table.
components.cost: By far the largest component, bigger than everything else combined, and the model takes tens of seconds to load the first time it is used in a session. Worth it only if you actually need numbers out of published figures.
